dimensions.criterion: A blinded review instrument exists, unperformed reviews remain explicitly unperformed, and no synthetic reviewer result is recorded.
Every public case study distinguishes what became usable, Jamie's contribution, outcome evidence, and transferable proof.
Every project exposes role, context, usable result, and role fit before deeper evidence and boundaries.
Every public project has a bounded visual candidate or linked public artifact, and descriptive cards are not misrepresented as visual evidence.
Every public project records coordination, constraints, continuity, and an explicit boundary against unsupported scale claims.
The role-focused public surface contains evidence-backed 2026 and current-practice signals.
Each priority audience has an existing route, selected proof path, and clear resume or contact action without adding public-route sprawl.
Collective credit remains visible, collaborator review is invited where consequential, and no approval is fabricated.
The full repository check runs locally and in pull requests, with staging and production preflights kept explicit.
A passing checked commit with no P0 blocker can be shared while P2 refinement and unrecorded external review continue in parallel.
